proposals.title: Proposal 4 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring separate Board Chairman and CEO, with the Chairman preferably independent and not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that the shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Access to COVID-19 Products
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether public financial support for COVID-19 therapeutics is considered in decisions affecting access, such as IP licensing or pricing.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that the shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 6 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Lobbying Expenditure Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual disclosure of direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots lobbying policies, payments, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that the shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
